material.de: Standard-Reduktionspotenziale bei298K: Zn²⁺/Zn−0,76V,Cu²⁺/Cu+0,34V. Reine Metalle, Aktivitäten gelöster Ionen1; getrennte Halbzellen mit inertem Salzsteg.
material.en: Standard reduction potentials at298K: Zn²⁺/Zn−0.76V,Cu²⁺/Cu+0.34V. Pure metals, dissolved-ion activities1; separated half-cells with inert salt bridge.

task.de: Interpretiere Spannungsreihe, sage freiwilligen Verlauf voraus, bilanziere Gesamtreaktion und berechne E°. Benenne Anode/Kathode, Elektronenfluss und Salzsteg-Ionenbewegung. Begrenze Aussagen für andere Konzentrationen.
task.en: Interpret the series, predict spontaneous direction, balance total reaction and calculate E°. State anode/cathode, electron flow and salt-bridge ion movement. Bound claims for other concentrations.

modelResponse.de: Zn oxidiert:Zn→Zn²⁺+2e⁻ an der negativen Anode;Cu²⁺+2e⁻→Cu an positiver Kathode. Gesamt Zn+Cu²⁺→Zn²⁺+Cu;E°=0,34−(−0,76)=1,10V. Elektronen fließen außen Zn→Cu; Anionen des Salzstegs zur Zn-Halbzelle, Kationen zur Cu-Halbzelle. Ionen transportieren Ladung in Lösung, keine Elektronenleitung dort. Reale Konzentrationen/Belastung können Spannung verändern.
modelResponse.en: Zn oxidizes:Zn→Zn²⁺+2e⁻ at negative anode;Cu²⁺+2e⁻→Cu at positive cathode. Overall Zn+Cu²⁺→Zn²⁺+Cu;E°=0.34−(−0.76)=1.10V. Electrons flow externally Zn→Cu; salt-bridge anions toward Zn and cations toward Cu half-cell. Ions carry charge in solution, not electrons. Actual concentrations/load can change voltage.

findings.reason: The original Sachkompetenz requires defining standard electrode potential. Current whole goal interpreting potentials can accommodate the definition, but both whole P cases merely supply relative standard reduction values and ask predictions/calculation. They specify activities/temperature but never require explaining the potential as a standard-condition relative half-cell value referenced to the standard hydrogen electrode. The sole exact definition role therefore needs targeted current P/source coverage clarification. This finding does not import the separately mapped SHE apparatus or experiment duties into this goal.
